patch_list: Claims today's daily check-in and today's Daily Rewards rung on their own, once a day, a few seconds after the app has loaded them — no ad and nothing to tap. The missed-days restore and the day-10/20/30 milestone claim are untouched.
Runs the Simosa daily check-in from a 24-hour WorkManager job that this patch adds to the app, with two-tier token auth, stale-token retry, a per-account day latch and a status notification.
Disables Simosa's anti-tamper signature check so a re-signed APK launches normally instead of stalling on the splash / "version is not correct" dialog.

Removes every ad (interstitial, banner, daily-reward) and every tracker (Mixpanel, Firebase, Facebook, AppsFlyer) — app events, network sends, ad-SDK requests (Google Ads / AppLovin / AnyMind / Prebid), SDK auto-collection, and the ipify I…
